title: Airwallex theme
description: A bright global-finance theme: white page, near-black ink, one electric violet for every action, a pale lavender wash and cool-grey footer. Five saturated 135° product gradients (orange, violet-magenta, blue-purple, teal-blue, magenta-red) live in highlight and the chart colours. One round geometric sans in three weights, 6px buttons and 16px cards. The dark sibling is the original's graphite bands.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's graphite bands (product universe, customers) read the .dark colours by putting `dark` on the section
gradient stops: highlight = orange-red, chart-1 = orange, chart-2 = magenta, chart-3 = blue, chart-4 = purple, chart-5 = teal; destructive doubles as the red end of the magenta card
name: airwallex-theme
